title: Kayak Flight Price Predictions Scraper
description: Get Kayak flight price predictions by route with date ranges, origin, destination, and minimum fare. Batch airport pairs to compare expected price trends.

batch.valueDescription: Origin used to run this search.

schema.description: Origin airport code for the route or destination search.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Kayak Flight Price Predictions | Route Trends
storeCopy.seoDescription: Review Kayak flight price predictions for airport routes. Export date ranges, origin and destination airports, and minimum fares to compare route trends.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve KAYAK flight price prediction rows for airport routes with date ranges and minimum fares. Batch origin-destination pairs to compare route-level price patterns.
useCases: Travel planners can compare predicted fare periods across routes.
Fare analysts can review route-level minimum-price patterns.
Travel agencies can prioritize routes for upcoming customer trips.
howToUse: Add origin and destination airports to each entry in `routes`.
Set `maxResults` to keep saved prediction rows within your desired size.
Compare each date range and minimum price across routes.

faqs.question: Does a prediction guarantee the future ticket price?
faqs.answer: No. KAYAK price predictions are estimates and can change as inventory and fares change.
